description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Infrastructure Engineer based in the United States. 

 The IT Infrastructure Engineer will serve as the senior technical lead for infrastructure and security engineering, helping shape and strengthen a secure, reliable, and scalable technology environment. You will lead the evolution toward a Zero Trust security model, protect sensitive health information, and drive improvements across cloud infrastructure, networks, and IT systems. The role combines hands-on engineering with strategic ownership, requiring you to design solutions, build automation, and establish technical standards. Working across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, and AWS, you will help ensure system resilience, performance, and compliance. You will also act as a technical escalation point, mentor colleagues, and collaborate with vendors and leadership. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced engineer who thrives on autonomy, complex challenges, and building solutions where no established playbook exists.

Accountabilities

 
 Lead the installation, configuration, maintenance, and upgrade of server, network, cloud, and security infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and related environments.



 
 Maintain infrastructure through regular patching, firmware updates, backups, and licensing management, including approving server patches and coordinating deployments with minimal business disruption.



 
 Establish and maintain configuration standards for servers and cloud workloads, including systems connected through third-party providers.



 
 Maintain architecture, network, backup, and recovery documentation, and plan and lead periodic disaster recovery testing.



 
 Design and drive the Zero Trust security roadmap across identity, devices, networks, applications, and data, implementing measures such as phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication, Conditional Access, and least-privilege administrative access.



 
 Configure and maintain monitoring solutions to identify abnormal system activity, lead incident response, and address IT and information security risks.



 
 Establish audit tools and processes to support SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance, including quarterly reviews of administrative and system access.



 
 Develop, test, and maintain automation using PowerShell, Python, AWS Lambda, and Microsoft Graph API to streamline identity, Microsoft 365, and cloud operations.



 
 Manage scripts and infrastructure-as-code assets in source control, and oversee automation for the managed file transfer platform, AWS Transfer Family.



 
 Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for the IT team, providing guidance and coaching on scripting, automation, infrastructure, and security practices.



 
 Coordinate with vendors and contractors, including conducting technical security assessments of third parties with access to protected health information (PHI).



 
 Work closely with leadership to prioritize initiatives, monitor key performance indicators, report progress, contribute to infrastructure budget management, and participate in relevant leadership meetings and committees.



 
 Take ownership of new and unproven technical projects, from research and solution design through implementation and production delivery.




 Requirements:


 
 At least 7 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or security engineering, including a minimum of 3 years in a senior or technical leadership role.



 
 Strong hands-on scripting and programming experience, particularly with PowerShell and Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or other scripting languages.



 
 Ability to read, write, test, and maintain production-quality code.



 
 Deep experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune security.



 
 Strong cloud infrastructure experience with Azure and/or AWS.



 
 Practical understanding of Zero Trust principles and core security fundamentals, including networking, DNS, email authentication, firewalls, and network segmentation.



 
 Experience supporting SOC 2 and/or HIPAA compliance requirements.



 
 Experience managing vendors, contractors, or managed service providers (MSPs).



 
 Strong technical judgment and the ability to establish standards, solve complex problems, and take ownership of initiatives with limited direction.



 
 Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, adapt to change, and challenge existing approaches constructively.



 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally in video meetings and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.



 
 Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance competing deadlines while maintaining focus on broader business priorities.



 
 Creative, solutions-oriented mindset, with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and finding practical ways forward.



 
 Willingness and ability to travel several times per year, including overnight stays for corporate gatherings, conferences, and/or health fairs.



 
 Reliable electricity and a secure internet connection with a minimum speed of 11 Mbps.



 
 A designated private workspace with minimal interruptions.



 
 Strong overall technological proficiency, including effective use of computers, peripheral equipment, Microsoft products, and business applications.



 
 Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.



 
 Successful completion of required background and reference checks before starting employment.




 Benefits:


 
 Market-competitive salary.



 
 Company stock options.



 
 Potential annual merit increases and performance-based bonuses, subject to the company's fiscal performance.



 
 Generous paid time off and paid holidays.



 
 Partially paid leave for qualifying family or medical reasons, subject to employment eligibility.



 
 Comprehensive health and insurance benefits, with a portion of premiums covered by the company. Available coverage includes:



 
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance.



 
 Life insurance.



 
 Short-term and long-term disability insurance.



 
 Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity coverage.



 
 Identity theft protection and pet insurance.





 
 Health benefits eligibility begins on the first day of the month following 60 days of employment.



 
 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 4%.



 
 401(k) eligibility begins on the first day of the month following 6 months of employment.



 
 Fully remote working environment.
